parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set system authentication-order radius.explanation: 配置系统的认证顺序为RADIUS。

parameters.name: authentication-order
parameters.explanation: 认证顺序，指定使用RADIUS进行认证。

set system radius-server 10.6.55.55 port.command: set system radius-server 10.6.55.55 port 1550 secret vS796FO7CpBCRqjgSCqRX6P!DYI@
set system radius-server 10.6.55.55 port.explanation: 配置RADIUS服务器的IP地址、端口号和共享密钥。

parameters.name: secret
parameters.explanation: 与RADIUS服务器通信的共享密钥。

set system services dhcpv6 dns-server 20.explanation: 配置DHCPv6服务的DNS服务器地址。

set routing-options rib inet6.0 static r.command: set routing-options rib inet6.0 static route 2001:DB8::/62 discard
set routing-options rib inet6.0 static r.explanation: 配置IPv6静态路由，指定下一跳为丢弃。

parameters.name: next-hop
parameters.explanation: 下一跳地址，此处为丢弃。

set access address-assignment pool pool1.template: set access address-assignment pool [parameter1] family inet6 prefix [parameter2] prefix-length [parameter3]
set access address-assignment pool pool1.command: set access address-assignment pool pool1 family inet6 prefix 2001:DB8::/64 prefix-length 64
set access address-assignment pool pool1.explanation: 配置IPv6地址分配池，指定前缀和前缀长度。

set access address-assignment pool pool2.template: set access address-assignment pool [parameter1] family inet6 prefix [parameter2] prefix-length [parameter3]
set access address-assignment pool pool2.command: set access address-assignment pool pool2 family inet6 prefix 2001:DB8::/62 prefix-length 63
set access address-assignment pool pool2.explanation: 配置IPv6地址分配池，指定前缀和前缀长度。

set interfaces ge-1/0/1.1 encapsulation.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/1.1 encapsulation vlan-ccc vlan-id 1
set interfaces ge-1/0/1.1 encapsulation.explanation: 配置接口的封装类型为VLAN-CCC，并指定VLAN ID。

set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 1 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet6 address [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 1 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 1 family inet6 address autoconfig
set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 1 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv6地址自动配置。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

parameters.name: address
parameters.explanation: 地址配置方式，此处为自动配置。

set interfaces ge-1/0/2 family inet6 add.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/2 family inet6 address 2001:DB8::/64 eui-64
set interfaces ge-1/0/2 family inet6 add.explanation: 配置接口的IPv6地址，使用EUI-64格式。

parameters.name: eui-64
parameters.explanation: 使用EUI-64格式生成接口标识符。

set interfaces ge-1/0/2 family inet6 add.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/2 family inet6 address autoconfig
set interfaces ge-1/0/2 family inet6 add.explanation: 配置接口的IPv6地址自动配置。

parameters.name: address
parameters.explanation: 地址配置方式，此处为自动配置。
